# Oasis Revenue Lab

> Revenue management for short-term rentals. Revenue managers build and run the pricing strategy, supported by one connected workspace and Oasis Revenue Lab's own AI revenue agent. Built from hands-on Dubai holiday-home operations, active in Europe, designed for short-term rental businesses worldwide.

Oasis Revenue Lab (ORL) is operated by Lux Oasis Advisory & Services LLC, registered in the Sharjah Free Zone, UAE. There are three kinds of fee: a software fee per property per month for the Revenue Agent (published, from AED 99), a management fee for Managed Revenue (quoted), and an individually quoted assisted pilot for agencies. Prices exclude VAT.

## Who it is for

- Holiday-home operators and property management companies
- Landlords and owners renting out their own property. An owner does not need to run a management company to work with ORL
- Businesses running leased units or units managed on behalf of owners
- Revenue managers and revenue teams serving their own clients

## Services

- [Managed Revenue](https://www.oasisrevenuelab.com/#hybrid): a management fee, quoted on the property or portfolio. ORL's revenue managers own the pricing strategy and bring the client the decisions, with the evidence behind them. The Revenue Agent workspace is included.
- [Revenue Agent](https://www.oasisrevenuelab.com/#pricing): a software fee per property, per month. The workspace and AI assistance on the client's own property or portfolio. It proposes with the evidence and the client approves. Graduated pricing: AED 99 each for properties 1 to 5, AED 89 each for properties 6 to 10, AED 79 each for properties 11 to 25, AED 69 each for properties 26 to 50, AED 59 each for properties 51 to 100. More than 100 properties is Enterprise pricing, agreed on the portfolio. Examples: 10 properties cost AED 940 per month, 25 cost AED 2,125, 50 cost AED 3,850. The same list is published in euros (from €25) and US dollars (from $27). No setup fee for connecting the Revenue Agent. Each account includes 30 AI questions a month plus 10 per property; daily briefs, alerts and reports never count, and extra questions come in packs of 50 for AED 49.
- [Pricing](https://www.oasisrevenuelab.com/#pricing): a price calculator for the Revenue Agent by number of properties, in AED, EUR and USD, and the three offers side by side.
- Consultancy: one focused engagement, quoted separately on portfolio size, also available to Revenue Agent clients, covering PriceLabs setup or review, floor price architecture per unit, and seasonal, event and minimum-stay strategy.
- [Listings and Direct Booking](https://www.oasisrevenuelab.com/#listings): listing optimisation and a direct booking site connected to the client's PMS, built with structured data and semantic markup.
- [ORL for Revenue Teams](https://www.oasisrevenuelab.com/#revenue-teams): an assisted agency pilot, quoted individually, not self-service. Revenue managers and agencies run several clients in one workspace, switch between portfolios and approve changes from Telegram, and each owner gets private access to their own dashboard and reporting. A licence to use the software, not a sale of it.

## How it works

- [A worked example](https://www.oasisrevenuelab.com/#workflow): a booking cancels, the manager reviews the guest price, comparable listings and estimated payout, approves a change in Telegram or on the dashboard, and ORL records what PriceLabs confirmed. Fictional property, example figures.
- [What the system reads](https://www.oasisrevenuelab.com/#intelligence): Airbnb search observed daily, market reference rates, the client's own reservation feed from the connected PMS, Airbnb and Booking.com campaign catalogues, events near each property, and regional news and conditions affecting demand.
- [Price changes from Telegram](https://www.oasisrevenuelab.com/#workflow): select the property, type the change, review the exact dates, currency and before-and-after price, tap Apply, and ORL reads PriceLabs back and reports the result.
- The workspace: portfolio performance, forecasts, goals and pace, OTA campaign assessment, events, reports and a persona profile that tunes the agent to the client's risk appetite and rules.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.oasisrevenuelab.com/#faq)

## Limits worth stating accurately

- Every change is proposed and waits for a person to approve it. Nothing is changed autonomously.
- Applying a change requires the relevant permissions on the account.
- "Saved and verified in PriceLabs" confirms the price in PriceLabs. It does not confirm the guest-facing price on Airbnb, Booking.com or any other channel. PMS and channel synchronisation run separately.
- Panels on the website marked "Illustrative" or "sample data" are recreated examples, not customer data.

- Dubai, UAE (JBR, Downtown, Business Bay, Marina): live

- Rest of Europe (UK, Spain, Portugal), United States and Asia: planned

## Free tool

- [Floor price calculator](https://www.oasisrevenuelab.com/#calculator): works out the minimum nightly rate a short-term rental needs to cover its costs.
